query: How do I update my latest employment or salary information for PR application?
reference_answer: Applications submitted before 26 June 2024:If there is a change in your employment details whilst your PR application is being processed, please upload the following documents for our reference:-a) A letter to state the purpose of submitted the additional supporting document(s), for example increment etc.b) Relevant documentary proof (for example, increment letter and/or latest payslip showing the increment etc.)via 'Ad-hoc submission' under 'Enquire Application status' at ICA e-Service.Applications submitted on or after 26 June 2024:For Singpass users, please log in to the e-Service via MyICA and select 'Update information' within your case summary page to provide the update.For Non-Singpass users, please log in to the e-Service with your submitted application Reference ID and select 'Update information' within your case summary page to provide the update.

answer: For applications submitted before 26 June 2024, submit a letter stating the employment detail change along with relevant proof via 'Ad-hoc submission' on ICA e-Service. For applications on or after 26 June 2024, log into MyICA or use Singpass to select 'Update information'. [Document 1]
